A little about me

Medical administrative support is part of my experience.

From May 2024 to August 2026, I worked remotely as a freelance Medical Administrative Back Office Specialist. My responsibilities included updating patient details and medical records, processing referrals, maintaining healthcare documentation, verifying files for missing or inconsistent information, and organizing digital records. I used EHR/EMR and healthcare management systems for administrative tasks and treated protected health information as confidential. My earlier office experience with payment records, invoice checks, account balances, and Excel reports strengthened my attention to detail, while teaching in Thailand helped me build communication and organization skills.

I understand the importance of following established workflows, checking information carefully, maintaining accurate documentation, and escalating unclear or sensitive matters to the appropriate person. I provide administrative support only and do not make clinical decisions or give medical advice.

Selected work

Sample projects I created

I made these sample projects to practise and demonstrate how I organize tasks, track follow-ups, and document routine office processes. The examples are fictional and were created independently for this portfolio; they are not work completed for a client.

Project 01 · Excel dashboard

Virtual Assistant Operations Dashboard

A multi-tab work-management workbook with a KPI dashboard, prioritized task queue, due-date tracking, dropdown status controls, conditional formatting, and usage/privacy guidance. Useful for general VA task tracking and adaptable to non-clinical admin workflows.

Project 02 · Workflow documentation

Privacy-Aware Admin Workflow Playbook

A structured operating playbook covering daily routines, request handling, quality checks, secure information handling, escalation boundaries, and a concise handover example.

Project 03 · Inbox operations

Inbox Triage & Follow-Up Kit

A practical routing matrix, tracker field guide, neutral response templates, end-of-day reconciliation checklist, and clear escalation rules for routine versus clinical requests.
